## Constitution Compliance

- [ ] CHK001 Feature preserves complete SurveyKita whole-app delivery
- [ ] CHK002 Feature uses only the allowed Laravel 13, Blade, Tailwind, Bun,
  Vite, MariaDB, and Pest stack
- [ ] CHK003 Feature avoids banned starter kits, admin panel generators,
  frontend frameworks, Bootstrap, npm, yarn, pnpm, and SQLite as main local DB
- [ ] CHK004 Routes, controllers, Blade views, buttons, validation,
  authorization, and tests are wired for visible behavior

## Domain Rules

- [ ] CHK005 Admin and mahasiswa access boundaries are explicit and tested
- [ ] CHK006 Google OAuth, if involved, is mahasiswa-only and restricted to the
  approved student email domain
- [ ] CHK007 Evaluation submission rules, if involved, enforce duplicate,
  inactive, expired, invalid score, required answer, and profile completion
  constraints
- [ ] CHK008 Calculation logic, if involved, is centralized in a service and
  covered by Pest tests

## Local Verification

- [ ] CHK009 Docker Compose MariaDB setup remains documented and usable
- [ ] CHK010 Bun build/dev commands remain documented and usable
- [ ] CHK011 Pest command passes for the feature's required behavior
- [ ] CHK012 No fake UI, placeholder dashboards, empty tests, dead routes,
  orphan controllers, unused services, or TODO-only core behavior remain
